summary.zh: Sandcastle支持用TypeScript编排隔离环境中的编程智能体。
summary.en: Sandcastle provides TypeScript orchestration for coding agents running inside sandboxes.

summary.zh: 汇集作者个人使用的工程代理技能。
summary.en: This repository collects engineering skills used in a personal agent configuration.

summary.zh: 作者称TLDraw绘图智能体表现进步，配色不错但箭头偏多。
summary.en: The author reports progress on a TLDraw drawing agent, praising its colors while noting heavy use of arrows.

summary.zh: 自建知识库可为业务代理提供记忆，并减少供应商绑定。
summary.en: A personally maintained wiki can supply business agents with durable context while reducing dependence on vendor memory services.

summary.zh: 用提交前钩子限制代理所写文件的大小，并提示拆分。
summary.en: A commit hook can cap staged agent-authored files at roughly 5,000 tokens and explain how to divide oversized files.

summary.zh: 状态机和归约器有助于让智能体生成的前端代码更稳健、易测试。
summary.en: State machines and reducers can give agent-built frontends clearer behavior and make subsequent changes easier to test.

summary.zh: 代理编码应兼顾精简上下文、自主验证与适度人工介入。
summary.en: Effective agent coding balances concise guidance, strong automated checks, navigable code, and selective human involvement.

summary.zh: 糟糕的智能体测试也暴露了代码库缺少质量约束。
summary.en: Poor agent tests can reveal missing quality safeguards in the surrounding codebase.

summary.zh: 只追求出码速度会把维护成本转嫁给后续工程师。
summary.en: Rapid delivery without long-term design can leave other engineers carrying the cleanup burden.

summary.zh: 将重复任务封装为脚本和技能，可减少智能体的令牌消耗与幻觉。
summary.en: Packaging recurring tasks into agent-controlled scripts and skills can reduce token spending and unreliable improvisation.

summary.zh: 小改动可直接实施，大任务先澄清需求再决定是否细化规划。
summary.en: Match planning effort to change size, clarifying larger work before deciding whether it needs a detailed task map.

summary.zh: 优质技能应明确用户偏好，并给模型保留执行空间。
summary.en: Useful skills communicate user priorities while leaving the model room to carry out the work.

summary.zh: 应明确要求编程智能体兼顾代码库的长期质量。
summary.en: Ask coding agents to consider long-term codebase quality alongside immediate task completion.

summary.zh: 明确改进目标，才能让代理持续优化代码库。
summary.en: Agents need a defined destination and relevant data to choose useful improvements autonomously.

summary.zh: 约束智能体并运用软件工程方法，有助于改善AI编码结果。
summary.en: The post argues that constraining coding agents brings developers back to established software engineering practices.

summary.zh: 精简AGENTS.md并按需展开指令，可降低上下文开销。
summary.en: Reduce agent instruction overhead by removing redundant rules, revealing detail as needed, and separating review standards.

summary.zh: 技能集1.3新增带验证证据的PR说明与规格实现功能。
summary.en: Skills v1.3 adds evidence-focused pull request descriptions and specification implementation using subagents.

summary.zh: 技能库升级可结合版本差异与历史调用记录评估工作流收益。
summary.en: The skills v1.3 update suggests comparing repository changes and recent usage to identify workflow improvements.

summary.zh: 技能集1.3版加入会话复盘功能，用于寻找工作流改进点。
summary.en: Version 1.3 of the skills collection introduces retrospective analysis of past agent conversations to identify workflow improvements.

summary.zh: 合理抽象配合严格检查，可约束智能体决策并节省词元。
summary.en: Useful abstractions and strict linting can narrow agent choices while reducing the code and tokens needed.

summary.zh: 复盘代理会话可发现仓库导航障碍和过时文档。
summary.en: Review recent agent sessions to identify navigation bottlenecks and stale documentation that waste tokens.

summary.zh: GitHub Actions可借助议题、标签和定时任务搭建智能体开发流水线。
summary.en: GitHub Actions can connect issues, labels, schedules, and pull requests into an experimental agent development pipeline.

summary.zh: 口述复杂需求后，让代理先复述意图可帮助核对理解。
summary.en: After a lengthy dictated request, ask the agent to restate its understanding before proceeding.

summary.zh: 用删除检验审视浅层模块，找出可移除的多余抽象。
summary.en: Assess whether shallow modules deserve to exist to identify abstractions that can be removed.

summary.zh: Effect的类型化错误与依赖注入有助于约束代理编程。
summary.en: Effect offers typed failures, dependency injection, and built-in facilities that can help guide TypeScript coding agents.

summary.zh: 一场直播访谈将讨论技能设计与智能体软件交付流程。
summary.en: An announced live interview with poteto will explore skills and faster software delivery through agents.

summary.zh: 阅读poteto等作者的技能文件，可学习技能设计思路。
summary.en: The author recommends studying skills written by poteto, dexhorthy, and emilkowalski to learn from their approaches.

summary.zh: 副作用使用和注释质量等规则，难以仅靠确定性检查判断。
summary.en: Judging effect usage and comment quality can exceed what deterministic lint rules can capture.

summary.zh: 把代理的实质性失误持续整理为项目编码规范。
summary.en: Build coding standards incrementally by recording meaningful agent mistakes and the rules needed to prevent them.

summary.zh: 设想让智能体定期修复一处规范违规，保持PR小而易审。
summary.en: A proposed skill would periodically correct one coding-standard violation through a narrowly scoped pull request.

summary.zh: 约束接口、可验证反馈与同步功能文档有助于代理可靠开发。
summary.en: Constrained interfaces, automated verification, and maintained feature descriptions help agents navigate and improve large applications.

summary.zh: 作者拟在支持快捷切换自定义模式时发布grill模式。
summary.en: The author plans to release a grill mode if built-in customization supports switching modes with Shift-Tab.

summary.zh: AI编码词典新增软件工厂条目，旨在澄清流行术语。
summary.en: An AI coding glossary adds an entry explaining the increasingly popular software factory concept.

summary.zh: 该项目用通俗解释帮助理解AI编程术语。
summary.en: This reference makes terminology from AI-assisted programming accessible through everyday explanations.

summary.zh: 改善代理的工具框架与工作环境，比追逐模型发布更值得投入。
summary.en: Prioritize improving agent tooling and working conditions over following every new model announcement.

summary.zh: 修复随意生成的代码库，需要改善模块、领域语言和可测试性。
summary.en: Recovering poorly structured AI code involves stronger module boundaries, shared domain terminology, and improved testability.

summary.zh: 拟议的PR技能将结合领域术语、验证证据与合并风险，方便人工审查。
summary.en: A proposed pull request skill would aid reviewers with domain terminology, verification evidence, and an assessment of merge risk.

summary.zh: 自动化应从每日少量任务起步，经核查与调整后逐步扩展。
summary.en: Begin automation with a small daily workload, inspect results, refine behavior, and expand as confidence grows.

summary.zh: 复盘技能会建议把模糊规范转为可自动执行的检查。
summary.en: The retrospective skill now proposes automated checks that turn recurring mistakes into enforceable constraints.

summary.zh: 主动推动团队采用AI编码，可成为个人贡献的新方向。
summary.en: Helping a team adopt AI coding can create professional value that might otherwise require outside assistance.

summary.zh: 拟开设的课程以设计和搭建个人智能体开发流水线为目标。
summary.en: A planned cohort would teach participants to design their own software factories alongside codebase design and review practices.

summary.zh: 把AI学习成果用于企业内训，可形成新的职业发展机会。
summary.en: Applying AI course knowledge to internal training can help establish expertise and create career opportunities.

summary.zh: 即将推出的retro技能会利用会话记录寻找改进机会。
summary.en: An upcoming retro skill will analyze session evidence to suggest improvements to repositories, skills, and agent guidance.

summary.zh: AI代写代码可能掩盖架构痛点，人仍需主动寻找战略性改进。
summary.en: Delegating implementation can hide architectural friction, so humans still need to seek broader improvements beyond individual tasks.

summary.zh: 用共享知识库连接口述输入、并行创作与夜间审查。
summary.en: A shared project wiki can coordinate dictated ideas, parallel knowledge work, and overnight reviews of the deliverable.

summary.zh: 智能体维护的文档容易积累过期内容和临时细节。
summary.en: Agent-maintained documentation can accumulate obsolete information and details relevant only to individual sessions.

summary.zh: 作者强调编程中长期设计决策的重要性正在上升。
summary.en: The author argues that long-term engineering decisions deserve greater attention than immediate implementation tactics.

summary.zh: 类型检查、测试和版本管理让代码任务比一般知识工作更易自动化。
summary.en: Coding offers agents automated checks, organized documentation, and versioned workspaces that many other knowledge tasks lack.

summary.zh: 用伪代码、图示或演示视频辅助审查AI生成的变更。
summary.en: Pseudocode, diagrams, test evidence, and narrated demonstrations can make agent-generated pull requests easier to assess.

summary.zh: 让新人负责风险可控的真实项目，并通过失败复盘培养判断力。
summary.en: Give junior developers meaningful projects with limited risk, adequate AI access, and support learning from failures.

summary.zh: show-me技能提供更直观的代码展示方式，方便阅读PR说明。
summary.en: The show-me skill supplies ways to present code that make pull request explanations easier to follow.

summary.zh: 作者建议后端开发在TypeScript基础上采用Effect。
summary.en: The author now advocates adding Effect to TypeScript backend development after overcoming earlier skepticism.

summary.zh: Effect文档通过清晰入门与逐步展开细节改善学习体验。
summary.en: The author praises Effect documentation for its accessible introduction and gradual presentation of detail.

summary.zh: 审查时减少代码量并控制复杂度，有助于减轻维护负担。
summary.en: Code review can reduce maintenance burden by removing unnecessary code while keeping control-flow complexity low.

summary.zh: 作者认为关键理解与集中实践能帮助快速跟上AI进展。
summary.en: The author suggests that a few conceptual breakthroughs and concentrated practice can help learners catch up with AI.

summary.zh: 作者认为无人值守工作流值得建立，而按规格实现的技能便于起步。
summary.en: The author favors unattended agent workflows while presenting specification implementation as a simpler starting point.

summary.zh: 自动审查与人工审查应共同承担代码质量检查。
summary.en: Expand automated code review while continuing to involve human reviewers.

summary.zh: 把反对空洞测试写入编码规范，可让审查技能据此检查。
summary.en: Recording a rule against tautological tests lets the code-review skill flag them during review.

summary.zh: 警惕代理数量崇拜、上下文膨胀与夸大的AI能力宣传。
summary.en: Excessive agent counts, bloated instructions, and sweeping claims about AI capabilities are warning signs of misguided workflows.

summary.zh: 可把慢查询告警串联为自动修复、智能体审查和人工验收流程。
summary.en: A proposed optimization loop connects slow-query alerts to implementation, automated review, and human approval.

summary.zh: 建议明确指定Skill工具与技能名，以调用其他技能。
summary.en: When composing skills, explicitly name the Skill tool and the target skill to request the invocation.

summary.zh: 缺少必要环境变量时应立即报错，避免智能体掩盖配置问题。
summary.en: Coding agents may avoid crashes, so required configuration should explicitly fail when an environment variable is absent.

summary.zh: 按规格实现的技能拟并行分派任务，并按原规格审查最终代码。
summary.en: An experimental skill would research a codebase, delegate tickets concurrently, verify the result against its specification, and clean up worktrees.

summary.zh: 代码库质量会影响智能体表现，因此工程基础仍然重要。
summary.en: Sound software engineering matters because coding agents depend on the quality of the codebase they modify.

summary.zh: 作者回忆在Next.js大会偶遇后来创建shadcn的开发者。
summary.en: The author recalls meeting the future creator of shadcn at a Next.js conference before knowing who he would become.

summary.zh: 理解复杂系统可优先依靠统一术语、深模块与代码阅读。
summary.en: Shared domain terms, deep modules, and reading implementation code can be more useful than maintaining complex system diagrams.

summary.zh: 设想在会话结束时更新规范并精简技能，让开发流程持续改进。
summary.en: A proposed end-of-session skill would refine coding standards and prune agent instructions to improve future work.

summary.zh: 作者发布十分钟视频，概览技能库中的25项技能。
summary.en: A ten-minute video introduces all 25 skills in the repository and explains their uses.

summary.zh: 将常见错误写入项目规范，可让审查技能据此检查。
summary.en: Record recurring agent mistakes in repository coding standards so the review skill can enforce those expectations.

summary.zh: 统一领域术语及其关系，有助于理解代码库。
summary.en: Consistent domain vocabulary and clearly understood relationships can make a codebase comprehensible without reading every implementation detail.

summary.zh: 作者用架构改进技能应对未审查内部实现的AI应用问题。
summary.en: The author turns to an architecture improvement skill after encountering problems in an app built without examining its internals.

summary.zh: 改进设计以消除整类错误，比不断补充防错测试更有价值。
summary.en: Seek designs that eliminate recurring categories of failure rather than relying solely on additional regression tests.

summary.zh: 预告将为mattpocock/skills提供插件。
summary.en: A plugin for the mattpocock/skills collection is planned.

summary.zh: wait-what技能可解释模块职责、文件变更和陌生语法。
summary.en: The wait-what skill can clarify module behavior, explain recent file changes, and unpack unfamiliar syntax.

summary.zh: 技能集1.2版新增输出精简与代理写作工具，并更新需求追问。
summary.en: Skills release 1.2 adds verbosity control and agent-oriented writing tools while revising the grill-me workflow.

summary.zh: 技能集1.2补充完整文档、Codex支持和多项交互工具。
summary.en: Skills v1.2 expands documentation, adds Codex compatibility, and introduces tools for setup, questionnaires, and clearer explanations.

summary.zh: wait-what技能将帮助用户理解代理难懂的表达。
summary.en: A planned wait-what skill addresses confusing agent explanations after passive tone instructions proved ineffective.

summary.zh: 作者设想让spawn技能识别终端工具并启动独立智能体处理任务。
summary.en: A proposed spawn skill would detect terminal tooling and launch additional independent agents to handle tasks.

summary.zh: 让代理采用简明技术英语并沿用项目术语，可统一表达。
summary.en: An experimental instruction pairs simplified technical English with vocabulary taken from project context files.

summary.zh: grill-me的批量提问模式可加快处理简单问题。
summary.en: The batch questioning mode in grill-me speeds up working through straightforward questions.

summary.zh: 作者批评AI生成的应用文案晦涩，连开发者也难以理解。
summary.en: The author criticizes an AI-built application whose wording is difficult even for its developer to understand.

summary.zh: 有效使用AI需要先提升所处理领域的专业能力。
summary.en: Improving expertise in the underlying task helps people use AI more effectively.

summary.zh: 作者强调领域术语在与代理协作时的价值。
summary.en: The author highlights domain vocabulary as a powerful aid when working with agents.

summary.zh: 作者将规格视为需求讨论的临时产物，主张完成后删除。
summary.en: The author treats specifications as disposable records of design decisions rather than permanent development artifacts.

summary.zh: 与代理建立共同术语，有助于减少行话造成的理解障碍。
summary.en: Developing shared vocabulary through discussion can make jargon-heavy agent responses easier to understand.

summary.zh: 作者正为技能库制作新的文档站点。
summary.en: A new documentation site for the skills repository is under development.

summary.zh: wayfinder通过研究与原型逐步规划项目，并维护任务地图。
summary.en: The wayfinder skill develops project plans incrementally through research, prototyping, discussion, and an issue-tracker map.

summary.zh: 推荐用wayfinder探索雄心较大的开发构想。
summary.en: The author recommends starting a wayfinder session to explore an ambitious development idea.

summary.zh: 技能库现可通过Claude Code插件安装，简化更新并减少命名冲突。
summary.en: A Claude Code plugin packages the skills with update management and namespaced commands to reduce naming conflicts.

summary.zh: 为上下文窗口保留余量，避免用无关内容占满它。
summary.en: Keeping context lean preserves space for useful information during agent work.

summary.zh: 作者主张开发者应更多承担工程策略与管理职责。
summary.en: The author argues that developers increasingly need to act as engineering strategists and managers.

summary.zh: 避免围绕单个模型过度调优，可让代理环境更适应模型升级。
summary.en: An agent environment that avoids dependence on one model can accommodate upgrades with fewer workflow disruptions.

summary.zh: 会话结束后可借助决策树选择继续、清空、交接、压缩或委派。
summary.en: A proposed decision tree helps choose among continuing a session, clearing it, handing off, compacting, or delegating to a subagent.

summary.zh: 作者的Claude Code技能插件已获批，等待版本发布。
summary.en: Approval of the Claude Code skills plugin paves the way for a managed installation in an upcoming release.

summary.zh: 作者建议即使窗口更大，也可尝试将上下文限制在十五万词元内。
summary.en: The author suggests using roughly 150,000 context tokens even when a model offers a million-token window.

summary.zh: 两个需求澄清技能将改为分轮提问，以节省时间和词元。
summary.en: Version 1.2 will group interview questions into rounds while preserving decision dependencies, reducing time and token use.

summary.zh: 问题范围超出预期时，可先深入澄清，再用wayfinder绘制工作地图。
summary.en: The author combines requirements questioning with wayfinder mapping when an issue turns out to involve substantially more work.

summary.zh: 用wayfinder编排技能，并在整体界面中分阶段细化原型。
summary.en: Coordinate custom skills through wayfinder and prototype interface sections progressively while preserving the surrounding design context.

summary.zh: 将互不依赖的问题分批询问，并后台研究，可减少澄清轮次。
summary.en: Batch independent clarification questions and run research in the background to shorten planning conversations.

summary.zh: 交流模型表现时应同时说明推理强度设置。
summary.en: Model comparisons should specify reasoning effort because behavior varies substantially across effort settings.

summary.zh: 忙碌不等于产出，工作应聚焦实际交付。
summary.en: Feeling busy can coexist with shipping nothing, making focus on delivery essential.

summary.zh: 把维护说明文档的精力转向让代码本身更易理解。
summary.en: Invest effort in clearer code so fewer explanatory documents require ongoing maintenance.

summary.zh: 技术面试可观察候选人如何质疑和引导AI的追问。
summary.en: AI questioning during interviews can reveal how candidates explain decisions, challenge suggestions, and steer the tool.

summary.zh: 遇到不懂的规划问题，可先交接给教学代理补课。
summary.en: When a planning interview exposes a knowledge gap, hand context to a teaching agent before continuing.

summary.zh: 大型任务应先绘制决策地图，再转为规格、工单和实现。
summary.en: For substantial work, wayfinder maps should feed into specifications, tickets, and implementation as separate stages.

summary.zh: 新教程演示从需求澄清到实现与审查的完整技能工作流。
summary.en: A new walkthrough connects requirements interviews, specifications, task breakdown, implementation, and review into one skills workflow.

summary.zh: 智能体由模型、运行控制机制及其所在环境共同构成。
summary.en: An agent combines a model with execution machinery and an environment in which it can operate.

summary.zh: 技能集新版扩展了从复杂规划到实现和审查的工作流。
summary.en: Version 1.1 expands the skills collection across ambitious planning, specifications, tickets, implementation, and review.

summary.zh: 用网络代理检查Claude Code提示，再调整配置清理冗余。
summary.en: Inspecting outgoing Claude Code prompts through a proxy can reveal excess content to remove through configuration.

summary.zh: 先测量Claude Code请求负载，再移除不用的工具与功能。
summary.en: Inspect Claude Code request overhead, then disable unused features and tool definitions to reduce recurring context costs.

summary.zh: 技能集1.1预告新增规划工具，并扩展外部PR分诊。
summary.en: The planned Skills v1.1 release adds planning tools and extends triage to pull requests from outside contributors.

summary.zh: 把开发服务器日志保存到文件并标注位置，方便代理排错。
summary.en: Saving development server output to a file and documenting its location lets agents inspect logs without controlling the server process.

summary.zh: 作者以Fable的事实错误提醒读者核查模型输出。
summary.en: Reported factual hallucinations during a brief Fable trial illustrate the need to verify model claims.

summary.zh: 代码审查可按深度分级，而非只能逐行阅读或完全不看。
summary.en: Code review has multiple levels, from detailed inspection to selective checks and understanding the purpose of changes.

summary.zh: wayfinder将多轮追问、原型和研究汇总到课程规划地图。
summary.en: The author uses wayfinder to consolidate questioning, prototyping, and research sessions into a shared course-planning map.

summary.zh: 相关技能将从PRD与问题命名改为规格文档与工单命名。
summary.en: The skills collection is renaming its PRD and issue conversion commands to reflect specifications and tickets.

summary.zh: 拟议的规划技能根据决策中的未知项，建议研究、原型或追问。
summary.en: A planning skill under development would identify unresolved decisions and suggest research, prototypes, or further questioning.

summary.zh: 掌握业务背景的代理，可协助课程规划与学员反馈查询。
summary.en: An agent with business context can support course planning and retrieval of student feedback.

summary.zh: wizard可为当前任务生成交互式命令行，辅助配置第三方服务。
summary.en: The wizard skill creates a task-specific interactive command line to help configure third-party services.

summary.zh: writing-great-skills将技能编写经验封装为可安装工具。
summary.en: The writing-great-skills tool packages guidance from the author into an installable resource for creating agent skills.

summary.zh: 作者将经典代码坏味道加入审查技能，为模型提供具体检查线索。
summary.en: The author is adding established refactoring smells to a review skill as concrete cues for model-based code inspection.

summary.zh: 代理定期汇入邮件与社群信息，构建供后续任务使用的知识库。
summary.en: An agent-managed wiki periodically gathers email and community messages as shared context for future automated workflows.

summary.zh: 泛泛而谈的技能要求可能无法有效改变智能体行为。
summary.en: Vague requests inside skills may have little influence on how an agent actually behaves.

summary.zh: 开发中的loop-me技能通过访谈寻找日常工作的AI委托机会。
summary.en: The upcoming loop-me skill interviews users to find everyday tasks suitable for delegation to AI.

summary.zh: 作者认为需求文档、研究记录和实施计划等临时产物未必适合入库。
summary.en: The author questions whether temporary agent planning artifacts, including requirements and research notes, should be tracked in Git.

summary.zh: 作者试用GLM-5.2学习魔方时，观察到大量推理文本。
summary.en: In a cube-learning experiment, the author observed unusually large reasoning traces from GLM-5.2.

summary.zh: 技能集首版提供使用咨询、技能编写指南及调用方式分类。
summary.en: The initial skills release adds usage advice, skill-authoring guidance, and a distinction between model-triggered and user-triggered skills.

summary.zh: 技能集首个正式版缩减描述开销，并区分用户与模型触发。
summary.en: The first major skills release reduces description token usage, separates invocation modes, and adds engineering workflow tools.

summary.zh: 在技能中使用含义集中的引导词，可帮助智能体维持行为方向。
summary.en: Carefully chosen recurring concepts can steer agent behavior by compactly expressing the intended approach.

summary.zh: 自动积累的代理记忆可能导致指令失效和行为难以引导。
summary.en: Automatically accumulated memories and guidance can make coding agents overreact to past lessons and become harder to steer.

summary.zh: 作者主张在编写需求文档前先理清设计分支，再逐步细化原型。
summary.en: The author proposes mapping design choices before writing requirements, then exploring those choices through increasingly detailed prototypes.

summary.zh: 作者考虑将teach技能独立成库，并补充示例与原理说明。
summary.en: The author proposes a dedicated repository for teach, with prompt examples and explanations of its learning principles.

summary.zh: 可用teach技能学习规划、验收和代码库设计等工程判断。
summary.en: Use the teach skill to study planning, quality assurance, and codebase design as strategic programming abilities.

summary.zh: teach技能将教学经验用于引导学习，并以魔方学习过程作演示。
summary.en: The teach skill applies teaching experience to guided learning, with solving a puzzle cube as an example.

summary.zh: teach技能已发布，可辅助学习软件基础等多种主题。
summary.en: The newly released teach skill supports learning across topics ranging from software concepts to music and puzzles.

summary.zh: teach会结合目标与学习记录，持续调整互动课程。
summary.en: The teach skill tailors interactive lessons to learner goals and ability, using progress records to guide subsequent sessions.

summary.zh: teach技能可辅助学习魔方、音乐等不同领域的知识。
summary.en: The teach skill has helped the author learn across domains, including solving a puzzle cube and arranging vocal harmonies.

summary.zh: 拟发布的AI编码词典旨在讲清模型、智能体、工具等基础概念。
summary.en: An upcoming AI coding dictionary aims to clarify foundational terms such as models, agents, tools, and harnesses.

summary.zh: 实现功能前先做准备性重构，可降低后续修改难度。
summary.en: Before implementing a feature, identify refactoring that would simplify the upcoming change.

summary.zh: 过宽的关键词触发条件可能让智能体误启复杂工作流。
summary.en: Overbroad keyword triggers can launch elaborate agent workflows when the user only mentions an unrelated task.

summary.zh: 准确表达排版与层级需求，有助于引导AI完成设计。
summary.en: Clear design vocabulary about spacing, line height, and hierarchy helps communicate visual requirements to AI.

summary.zh: 作者评测Cursor新推出的高强度AI代码审查命令。
summary.en: The post introduces an evaluation of a new Cursor command intended for especially rigorous AI code review.

summary.zh: 需求追问应控制范围与强度，并通过主动讨论和原型推进。
summary.en: Use focused, active requirements interviews supported by prototypes, without excessive questioning or premature context clearing.

summary.zh: 需求追问应控制范围，遇到依赖视觉体验的问题先做原型。
summary.en: Keep requirements discussions narrowly scoped and prototype questions that need visual or interactive evidence before resolving them.

summary.zh: 技能应简洁、职责集中，并支持组合与按需加载。
summary.en: Useful agent skills stay focused, compose with others, reveal detail when needed, and avoid dependence on a particular harness.

summary.zh: 作者计划拆解优质技能，结合实测解释其有效设计。
summary.en: A proposed series would test strong skills, explain their design, and identify ideas readers can adapt.

summary.zh: 交接技能可在规划与原型会话之间传递上下文并返回。
summary.en: The handoff skill transfers work between agent sessions, supporting round trips from planning to prototyping.

summary.zh: 编程需要兼顾眼前实现与长期设计，不能只看短期产出。
summary.en: Sound programming combines immediate implementation choices with decisions about the long-term direction of the system.

summary.zh: 优化大模型应用宜先明确评估标准，再从简单低成本方法逐步尝试。
summary.en: LLM application improvements should follow measurable evaluations, starting with inexpensive techniques before escalating complexity.

summary.zh: 直播将结合需求追问、交接与原型技能完成一次功能开发。
summary.en: A live demonstration will build a complete feature using requirements interviewing, handoff, and prototyping skills.

summary.zh: 精简技能内容有助于降低审计、维护和词元成本。
summary.en: Shorter skills are easier to inspect and maintain while consuming fewer tokens during use.

summary.zh: 架构改进技能即将支持输出HTML。
summary.en: The architecture improvement skill is expected to gain HTML output.

summary.zh: 作者称新的月度额度会大幅压缩Claude Code无人值守用量。
summary.en: The author reports that a dedicated monthly credit substantially reduces allowances for unattended Claude Code work.

summary.zh: 作者认为订阅调整压缩了Claude的程序化使用空间。
summary.en: The author criticizes subscription changes as reducing programmatic Claude usage and suggests exploring Codex.

summary.zh: 新增技能支持将会话保存为Markdown交接，并为前后端制作原型。
summary.en: New handoff and prototype skills preserve session context in Markdown and support exploring frontend or backend ideas.

summary.zh: 需求不明时先试做界面原型，再将结论摘要带回规划对话。
summary.en: When a planning question requires experimentation, iterate on a UI prototype, then resume planning with a summarized result.

summary.zh: 作者认为用低保真原型探索方案，比堆积长篇规格更有效。
summary.en: The author reports better outcomes from replacing extensive written plans with rough prototypes.

summary.zh: 把日常任务封装为技能，并建立共同术语，可探索更自主的代理工作。
summary.en: Reusable skills and shared vocabulary can turn everyday tasks into workflows requiring less continuous supervision.

summary.zh: 先追问和验证原型，再拆分任务交给智能体实现。
summary.en: Clarify requirements, validate a prototype, turn decisions into issues, and then run implementation agents.

summary.zh: grill-with-docs通过追问统一术语，并记录重要架构取舍。
summary.en: The grill-with-docs skill combines design interviews with a shared glossary and selective architecture decision records.

summary.zh: triage将外部反馈整理为可执行任务、补充问题或有理由的关闭。
summary.en: The triage skill classifies incoming reports and prepares actionable briefs, clarification requests, or documented closures for user approval.

summary.zh: 使用AI生成代码后，开发者仍需认真审查并负责质量。
summary.en: Developers remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated work rather than treating inexpensive generation as permission to neglect quality.

summary.zh: 代理由模型、工具框架和可交互环境共同构成。
summary.en: An agent combines a predictive model with orchestration, tools, and an environment it can observe and change.

summary.zh: 生成代码成本低，并不代表后续维护也便宜。
summary.en: Cheap code production can still create substantial ongoing maintenance costs.

summary.zh: AI提速也可能加重代码库混乱，需要主动整顿。
summary.en: Faster AI-assisted development can also increase software disorder, creating a need for deliberate codebase cleanup.

summary.zh: 技能更新将代码库追问与通用追问分开，并扩展议题跟踪工具支持。
summary.en: A skills update distinguishes codebase questioning from general questioning and broadens compatibility with issue trackers.

summary.zh: Sandcastle作为作者自建的软件工厂工具已开源。
summary.en: Sandcastle is released as an open-source implementation of the software factory approach.

summary.zh: Evalite提供用TypeScript评估大模型应用的工具。
summary.en: Evalite lets developers assess applications powered by language models through TypeScript.

summary.zh: 作者征集文档站与插件市场等方案，以提升技能库的易发现性。
summary.en: The author seeks feedback on documentation and plugin distribution to make a popular skills repository easier to navigate.

summary.zh: 无人值守实现需要明确任务、自动审查及持续人工验收支撑。
summary.en: Unattended implementation depends on clear tickets, automated reviews, and repeated human planning and quality checks.

summary.zh: 架构改进技能新增术语表，帮助描述代码库的设计质量。
summary.en: The architecture improvement skill now includes vocabulary for discussing strengths and weaknesses in codebase design.

summary.zh: 作者的一场演讲强调软件基础在AI时代仍然关键。
summary.en: A shared talk argues that software fundamentals remain especially valuable as AI development tools advance.

summary.zh: 新技能组合串联领域建模、需求文档、任务分诊与测试驱动开发。
summary.en: The revised skill lineup covers domain discussions, requirements documents, dependent issues, state-based triage, and test-driven implementation.

summary.zh: 统一领域语言、划分边界并记录决策，可改善智能体协作。
summary.en: Shared domain language, bounded contexts, and decision records can improve agent alignment and codebase navigation.

summary.zh: 作者质疑Claude订阅在SDK与CI场景中的使用边界。
summary.en: The post highlights uncertainty about applying Claude subscription permissions to SDK integrations and CI workflows.

summary.zh: 规划应先通过提问达成共识，避免过早生成无人阅读的计划。
summary.en: Planning should establish mutual understanding through questions before producing a document.

summary.zh: ts-reset调整常见JavaScript接口的类型定义。
summary.en: The ts-reset package refines TypeScript definitions for frequently used JavaScript APIs.

summary.zh: 帖子称npm公开包中的映射文件意外暴露了Claude Code源码。
summary.en: The post reports that an accidentally published npm source map appears to have exposed substantial Claude Code source code.

summary.zh: 对模型陈述先保持怀疑，再要求它查阅来源验证。
summary.en: Treat model assertions as unverified until the agent has consulted supporting sources.

summary.zh: 让AI逐项追问并给出建议，可在动手前澄清需求。
summary.en: An interviewing skill explores dependent design decisions and recommends answers to clarify requirements before implementation.

summary.zh: 案例通过需求澄清、任务拆解和自动执行改进课程管理功能。
summary.en: A course management feature illustrates moving from requirements questions to tickets, autonomous implementation, and quality checks.

summary.zh: 作者实验发现，超长编码会话可能削弱模型判断与指令遵循。
summary.en: The author reports poorer coding decisions and instruction adherence when testing sessions beyond 100,000 tokens.

summary.zh: 该演示展示真实代码库中从需求构思到无人值守实现和验收的流程。
summary.en: The walkthrough demonstrates feature delivery in an existing codebase, from the initial idea through autonomous implementation and quality assurance.

summary.zh: 把需求澄清、任务拆分和测试流程封装成技能，便于代理复用。
summary.en: Skills package repeatable engineering processes such as requirements discovery, task breakdown, and test-driven development for coding agents.

summary.zh: 先用原型明确方案，再写需求并拆为任务，可指导AI实施。
summary.en: Early prototypes can clarify design choices before requirements are written and split into implementation tickets.

summary.zh: 用技能固化需求澄清、规格编写与测试流程，可提高代理产出质量。
summary.en: Reusable skills encode engineering processes, guiding agents through clarification, specifications, and testing to improve code quality.

summary.zh: 通过模块边界测试与即时反馈，可更稳妥地把实现交给AI。
summary.en: Boundary-level integration tests and immediate automated feedback help developers delegate implementation while managing AI-generated changes.

summary.zh: 课程通过规划、持久指引和反馈闭环培养AI编码能力。
summary.en: A Claude Code course combines phased planning, reusable guidance, feedback loops, and selective human involvement to develop AI-assisted engineering practices.

summary.zh: 连续追问可帮助在编写需求文档时细化设计决策。
summary.en: An extended grill-me session illustrates using repeated questions to refine a product requirements document.

summary.zh: 清晰接口、深模块与行为测试，有助于代理理解并修改代码。
summary.en: Deep modules with explicit interfaces and behavioral tests make code easier for agents to navigate and validate.

summary.zh: 仅在说明文件指定包管理器，智能体仍可能选错。
summary.en: A package-manager preference written in agent documentation may still be ignored during command execution.

summary.zh: 用执行前钩子拦截不合规命令，并提示代理使用指定工具。
summary.en: PreToolUse hooks can reject disallowed shell commands and return corrective feedback, enforcing CLI choices beyond written reminders.

summary.zh: 作者认为自动初始化的项目说明会过时，并增加提示词与令牌负担。
summary.en: The author warns that automatically initialized Claude guidance can become stale and add unnecessary prompt and token overhead.

summary.zh: 自动生成的代理说明易冗余过时，应让代理按需探索源码。
summary.en: Automatically generated repository guidance can waste context and become stale; agents can instead discover details from source files.

summary.zh: 先编写会失败的测试，可为智能体实现提供明确反馈。
summary.en: Starting with a failing test gives coding agents a concrete target for implementation.

summary.zh: 作者推荐默认通过worktree选项启动Claude编码会话。
summary.en: The author recommends making the worktree launch option the default for Claude Code sessions.

summary.zh: 该工作流将想法转为需求与看板，再由Ralph执行并交给人工验收。
summary.en: The workflow turns ideas into requirements and tickets, runs Ralph to implement them, and finishes with manual quality assurance.

summary.zh: 规划时要求模型逐项追问设计分支，有助于澄清需求依赖。
summary.en: Ask the agent to explore unresolved design choices through questions until requirements and decision dependencies are understood.

summary.zh: AI编程更需要明确模块接口、强反馈机制与原型验证。
summary.en: AI-driven development increases the value of explicit module interfaces, automated feedback, and early prototyping.

summary.zh: 编写测试时，应避免重复验证类型系统已保证的性质。
summary.en: Focus tests on behavior beyond compile-time guarantees instead of duplicating checks already enforced by types.

summary.zh: 新TDD技能强调验证真实行为，避免生成大量依赖实现细节的测试。
summary.en: A new TDD skill for Claude Code prioritizes necessary behavioral tests over numerous tests tied to implementation details.

summary.zh: 通过钩子拦截危险Git操作，可约束自动编码循环。
summary.en: Hooks can restrict dangerous Git operations during autonomous coding loops, including runs inside Docker sandboxes.

summary.zh: 让智能体逐个完成失败测试与最小实现，再在测试通过后重构。
summary.en: Guide agents through one failing behavioral test and minimal implementation at a time, then refactor after the tests pass.

summary.zh: 沙箱内仍有Git误操作风险，可用执行前钩子拦截危险命令。
summary.en: Sandbox isolation leaves repository history exposed, so command hooks can block matching destructive Git operations before execution.

summary.zh: 作者分享覆盖需求、重构、测试、接口设计及技能编写的技能组合。
summary.en: The author shares a toolkit spanning requirements, refactoring requests, test-driven development, interface design, and skill creation.

summary.zh: 从小功能开始循环规划、执行与检查，可积累代理协作经验。
summary.en: Practice on small features by planning, allowing edits, inspecting results, and starting fresh context for the next task.

summary.zh: 该仓库集中管理作者的内部开发工具。
summary.en: This monorepo brings together the internal tools used by the author.

summary.zh: 建议随依赖包分发对应版本的技能文档。
summary.en: The author proposes bundling version-specific package documentation as skills alongside installed dependencies.

summary.zh: 作者认为Ralph应在每项任务后重置上下文，以维持模型表现。
summary.en: The author criticizes a Ralph plugin for retaining context instead of resetting it between tasks.

summary.zh: 作者的Ralph流程已能在无人值守时处理GitHub任务。
summary.en: The author reports an evolved Ralph setup that resolves GitHub issues autonomously while other work continues.

summary.zh: 每轮重启智能体并读取进度文件，可避免会话历史持续膨胀。
summary.en: Restarting an agent between loop iterations and reloading saved progress prevents conversation history from accumulating indefinitely.

summary.zh: 先打通最小端到端功能并验证，再扩展其余实现。
summary.en: Build and test a minimal feature across system layers before expanding, so faulty assumptions surface early.

summary.zh: 用jq筛选Claude流式JSON，可实时查看Ralph执行并检测完成信号。
summary.en: Filtering Claude streaming JSON with jq exposes live progress while preserving the final result for Ralph completion checks.

summary.zh: 无人值守编码依靠任务队列与自动反馈，让开发者专注架构和验收。
summary.en: Autonomous coding shifts developers toward backlog curation, architecture, and QA while agents select and execute tasks through feedback loops.

summary.zh: 冗杂或低质的智能体说明文件可能浪费词元并削弱输出质量。
summary.en: Poorly maintained agent instruction files can consume extra tokens and impair coding results.

summary.zh: 精简AGENTS.md并按需提供细节，可减少无关指令干扰。
summary.en: Keep repository-wide agent guidance minimal and disclose specialized detail only when relevant to preserve context and reduce confusion.

summary.zh: 类型检查、测试与提交钩子让编码智能体能发现错误并自行修正。
summary.en: Type checking, automated tests, and commit hooks give coding agents repeatable feedback to detect and repair mistakes.

summary.zh: 调整CLAUDE.md可引导规划输出更简短，并提出后续问题。
summary.en: Project instructions can steer plan mode toward concise proposals and useful follow-up questions.

summary.zh: 让计划保持简短，并列出待决问题，便于执行前对齐。
summary.en: Keep implementation plans brief and expose open questions so people can resolve uncertainty before coding begins.

summary.zh: 让AI接入浏览器，可补足前端开发中的运行反馈。
summary.en: Giving coding agents browser access helps them observe frontend behavior in its actual runtime environment.

summary.zh: 先探索仓库并澄清需求，再沿用规划上下文执行，可减少错误假设。
summary.en: Planning builds repository knowledge and clarifies requirements before execution, giving the agent a better-informed starting point.

summary.zh: 编码前应通过追问和代码探索对齐需求，避免仓促形成大计划。
summary.en: Align requirements through conversation and codebase exploration before implementation, using questions to challenge assumptions.

summary.zh: Ralph循环依据需求与进度记录，逐项实现、检查并提交任务。
summary.en: A Ralph loop repeatedly selects one task from requirements, validates its implementation, records progress, and commits before continuing.

summary.zh: 作者发布包含11条Ralph使用建议的长文。
summary.en: A newly announced article collects eleven tips for working with Ralph in AI coding workflows.

summary.zh: Ralph循环读取需求与进度，每次完成一个任务并提交。
summary.en: A Ralph loop repeatedly selects work from requirements and progress files, implements one task, and commits incremental results.

summary.zh: 自主循环应限定小任务、保存进度，并用测试和类型检查反馈。
summary.en: Keep autonomous coding iterations small, persist progress, and use tests and type checks to guide subsequent work.

summary.zh: 作者分享用于给未覆盖功能补充测试的Ralph脚本。
summary.en: A shared Ralph script targets features that lack tests and automates adding coverage.

summary.zh: 在Docker沙箱中运行Claude，可隔离自动编码操作。
summary.en: A Docker sandbox confines Claude coding activity to an isolated environment associated with the current workspace.

summary.zh: 该演示介绍用简单循环让编程智能体持续自主执行任务。
summary.en: The demonstration explains a simple loop that repeatedly runs a coding agent for unattended development.

summary.zh: Ralph通过有限循环重启智能体，每轮完成单项需求并记录进度。
summary.en: Ralph repeatedly starts fresh agent sessions for individual requirements, using progress records, checks, and explicit stopping conditions.

summary.zh: Evalite v1测试版内置十种评分器，并默认使用内存存储。
summary.en: The Evalite v1 beta adds ten built-in scorers and starts with in-memory storage to simplify evaluation setup.

summary.zh: 个人软件可让AI承担重复劳动，同时由人保留判断与审核。
summary.en: Tailored personal applications can automate repetitive AI work while keeping decisions and review with the user.

summary.zh: 以评测驱动开发，可及时检验上下文设计和澄清工具效果。
summary.en: Evaluation-driven iteration provides quick feedback when refining context design and a clarification tool.

summary.zh: 作者认为，掌握基础后，与AI协作的困难可能反映沟通问题。
summary.en: The author suggests that difficulties collaborating with AI can resemble difficulties working with people once technical basics are understood.

summary.zh: 将AI编码任务分阶段规划，有助于组织开发流程。
summary.en: The author treats phased plans and planning mode as essential tools for organizing AI-assisted implementation.

summary.zh: 状态栏展示仓库、Git变更与上下文占用，便于判断下一步操作。
summary.en: A customized status line exposes repository state and context usage, helping decide when to continue or begin a fresh session.

summary.zh: 分享用Claude Code实现功能的十分钟工作流演示。
summary.en: A ten-minute demonstration walks through implementing a feature with Claude Code.

summary.zh: 理解上下文窗口有助于分析模型在长对话中的表现下降。
summary.en: Understanding context windows helps explain why model responses can deteriorate during extended conversations.

summary.zh: Claude Code通过交互界面询问测试用例需求。
summary.en: Claude Code demonstrates an interactive interface for asking users which test cases they want.

summary.zh: 用简短计划配合末尾待决问题，可提高规划讨论的可操作性。
summary.en: Brief plans followed by outstanding questions make planning discussions easier to act on.

summary.zh: 倡议统一不同编码代理所用的规则文件。
summary.en: The author advocates standardizing instruction files across coding tools instead of maintaining tool-specific alternatives.

summary.zh: 使用编码智能体时，人仍应保留独立思考与判断的责任。
summary.en: Developers should retain responsibility for reasoning when using coding agents to protect both code quality and their own skills.

summary.zh: 作者体验中，规划模式显著改善代码质量，但仍需审查缺陷。
summary.en: The author reports substantially better Claude Code output with plan mode, while still catching occasional bugs during review.

summary.zh: 把AI计划保存在GitHub议题中，可减少仓库里的临时文档。
summary.en: Store agent plans as GitHub issues to avoid accumulating disposable planning documents in the repository.

summary.zh: 作者通过全局说明要求极简输出，减少模型回复的冗长表达。
summary.en: A global Claude instruction favoring extreme brevity produces responses the author finds more useful.

summary.zh: 要求模型极度精简输出，可降低阅读负担与生成成本。
summary.en: Explicit brevity instructions can make model responses easier to scan and less expensive to generate.

summary.zh: 词元把文本编码为模型可处理的数字，也是计费的重要单位。
summary.en: Tokenization maps text fragments to numeric identifiers for model processing, and usage costs account for both incoming and generated tokens.

summary.zh: 工具调用由模型提出、应用执行，再通过对应结果消息反馈给模型。
summary.en: Models request tool actions through messages, while applications execute them and return matching results to continue the conversation.

summary.zh: 模型只提出工具调用，应用负责执行并反馈结果或错误。
summary.en: Models propose tool calls; application code executes them and returns outcomes or errors for further reasoning.

summary.zh: 固定流程由代码安排步骤，智能体则自行选择工具与结束时机。
summary.en: Workflows encode the sequence of operations, while agents choose tools and decide when their work is complete.

summary.zh: 免费入门教程讲解提示、词元、上下文及工具使用的限制。
summary.en: A free fundamentals series covers system prompts, numeric text representation, context limits, tool overload, and when agents are useful.

summary.zh: 上下文窗口同时容纳输入与输出，过长历史可能削弱模型对中段信息的关注。
summary.en: Context capacity covers both input and output, and longer histories can make information in the middle harder for models to use.

summary.zh: Anthropic发布新的代理SDK，其文档优先展示TypeScript。
summary.en: Anthropic announces a new agent SDK whose documentation presents TypeScript by default.

summary.zh: 调整输入数据的表示格式，可减少发送给大模型的词元。
summary.en: Using a more compact representation for input data can reduce language-model token consumption.

summary.zh: 分享介绍系统提示、工具调用和推理词元的入门资料。
summary.en: An introductory resource covers system prompts, tool calls, reasoning tokens, and the structure of model conversations.

summary.zh: 作者发布短视频，介绍令牌的作用及其词表构建方式。
summary.en: A short explainer covers what model tokens are, why they exist, and how token vocabularies are constructed.

summary.zh: 结构化输出可将杂乱文本转为便于检索的数据对象。
summary.en: Structured output turns unorganized text and data into objects that applications can search and process.

summary.zh: 作者正在开发支持录制时同步剪辑的视频编辑器。
summary.en: The author is building a video editor that supports making edits while recording.

summary.zh: 面向用户的AI应用需要应对任意问题乃至破坏性输入。
summary.en: An AI application must account for users submitting unrestricted questions or deliberately trying to disrupt it.

summary.zh: 用快速模型先做简短安全判定，再决定是否继续处理请求。
summary.en: A fast model can screen conversation history with a minimal classification response before the application continues normal generation.

summary.zh: 作者宣布将未来三年的技术重心转向AI SDK。
summary.en: The author plans to focus on the AI SDK after three years centered on TypeScript.

summary.zh: 介绍用AI SDK为应用生成后续问题建议的方案。
summary.en: A shared AI SDK pattern adds suggested follow-up questions to AI applications.

summary.zh: AI SDK可合并回答与追问建议的数据流，让前端逐步展示建议。
summary.en: AI SDK can combine an answer stream with structured follow-up suggestions so the interface receives suggestions incrementally.

summary.zh: 用通配忽略规则，让临时脚本与本地输出保持在版本控制之外。
summary.en: A filename pattern in gitignore can exclude local scratch scripts and saved results without adding individual ignore entries.

summary.zh: 模板字面量类型可为多个功能自动推导错误码。
summary.en: Template literal types can derive typed error codes across multiple features, as illustrated by the Chat SDK example.

summary.zh: 帖子报告tsgo将Sentry大型代码库的类型检查从54.8秒降至6.8秒。
summary.en: A reported tsgo trial cuts type checking in the large Sentry codebase from 54.8 seconds to 6.8 seconds.

summary.zh: string与空对象类型相交，可在宽松字符串类型中保留补全提示。
summary.en: Intersecting string with the empty object type enables flexible string inputs while retaining autocomplete suggestions in library APIs.

summary.zh: 作者免费发布了一本耗时九个月编写的TypeScript书籍。
summary.en: The author released a TypeScript book at no charge after spending nine months writing it.

summary.zh: 作者批评默认生成的TS配置目标过旧，并包含冗余设置。
summary.en: The author criticizes generated TypeScript configuration for an outdated target, CommonJS defaults, and an already-enabled filename casing check.

summary.zh: TypeScript元组可为元素命名，以说明各位置的含义。
summary.en: TypeScript supports named tuple elements, allowing an array position to carry a descriptive label.

summary.zh: 模板字面量类型可约束Authorization请求头的字符串格式。
summary.en: Template literal types can constrain authorization header strings to the expected format.

summary.zh: Composites提案探索解决JavaScript对象结构比较问题。
summary.en: The proposed Composites feature explores object-structure comparison in JavaScript as Records and Tuples lose momentum.

summary.zh: 谷歌的Agent2Agent协议面向代理间通信。
summary.en: The post introduces the Google Agent2Agent communication protocol and shares a diagram-based exploration of its technical documentation.

summary.zh: 可按用途统一命名风格，如类型用大驼峰、文件名用连字符。
summary.en: A suggested naming scheme uses PascalCase for types and hyphenated filenames, with separate conventions for constants, databases, and other identifiers.

summary.zh: AI工程侧重整合现有模型，构建可靠且可评估的应用。
summary.en: AI engineering applies existing models to reliable software products, with substantial work in integration, evaluation, and application design.

summary.zh: 构建可靠的大模型应用，需要以明确指标和真实用户数据持续评估改进。
summary.en: Reliable LLM products require measurable success criteria and repeated experiments evaluated against real usage data.

summary.zh: 该示例介绍用简短代码加入思考工具，辅助Claude解决问题。
summary.en: The example implements a small deliberation tool intended to improve Claude problem solving.

summary.zh: 给模型添加返回思考内容的工具，可在多步调用间保留推理线索。
summary.en: A think tool echoes its input into conversation context, allowing the model to retain reflections between subsequent tool calls.

summary.zh: 大模型能把零散文档转为结构化数据，便于检索和分析。
summary.en: LLMs can extract structured records from messy documents, making previously difficult data easier to search and analyze.

summary.zh: AI工程学习路线涵盖模型基础、选型与应用改进方法。
summary.en: A learning roadmap introduces model fundamentals, model selection, engineering principles, and techniques for improving AI applications.

summary.zh: 选择模型应同时权衡部署方式、费用、响应速度和任务表现。
summary.en: Model selection involves balancing hosting arrangements, operating costs, response latency, and performance on the intended task.

summary.zh: 预训练形成模型参数，推理时再根据输入词元逐步生成输出。
summary.en: Pretraining produces learned parameters, while inference uses those parameters and a sampling strategy to generate tokens from supplied context.

summary.zh: 作者发布十课MCP教程，涵盖从协议入门到发布服务器的过程。
summary.en: A newly published ten-lesson MCP tutorial guides learners from basic concepts toward releasing their own servers.

summary.zh: 为Claude Code配置项目级GitHub MCP服务，可接入仓库工具。
summary.en: Configure a project-scoped GitHub MCP server in Claude Code to make GitHub tools available to the agent.

summary.zh: MCP使用标准输入输出通信时，日志应另写文件以免干扰协议。
summary.en: For MCP connections over standard input and output, redirect application logs to a file to avoid corrupting protocol messages.

summary.zh: 把传输状态移入Redis，可减少MCP服务对进程内存的依赖。
summary.en: The article proposes externalizing MCP transport state to Redis to make server processes compatible with serverless deployment.

summary.zh: 教程用TypeScript讲解MCP服务器开发、npm分发与无服务器部署。
summary.en: The tutorial covers building TypeScript MCP servers and distributing them through npm or serverless hosting.

summary.zh: 将MCP服务打包发布到npm后，可通过npx分发运行。
summary.en: Package an MCP server with an executable entry point so users can launch published versions through npx.

summary.zh: TypeScript宣布以Go重写，并称编辑器与命令行性能将大幅提升。
summary.en: An announced Go rewrite of TypeScript promises roughly tenfold performance gains for editor tooling and command-line operations.

summary.zh: MCP服务器也能提供带参数的提示模板，让客户端复用常见操作。
summary.en: MCP servers can distribute parameterized prompt templates that clients expose as reusable workflow commands.

summary.zh: MCP宿主通过独立客户端连接各服务，并用JSON-RPC交换消息。
summary.en: An MCP host uses separate client connections to communicate with servers through JSON-RPC messages over a transport.

summary.zh: 该示例展示可连接多种客户端的精简MCP服务端。
summary.en: The example presents a compact MCP server usable by multiple development clients.

summary.zh: 分享用单个TypeScript文件搭建MCP服务并接入Claude的教程。
summary.en: A tutorial demonstrates connecting Claude Code to an MCP server implemented in one TypeScript file without a build step.

summary.zh: 理解MCP时应区分客户端、服务端与通信协议。
summary.en: Distinguish MCP clients, servers, and the communication protocol to avoid ambiguity when discussing integrations.

summary.zh: 单个TypeScript文件可通过标准输入输出向客户端提供MCP工具。
summary.en: Expose TypeScript functions as MCP tools from one file, using standard input and output without a separate build step.

summary.zh: 作者考虑根据读者反响制作免费MCP教程。
summary.en: The author proposes creating a free MCP tutorial if the post attracts sufficient interest.

summary.zh: 通过重构Jina的DeepSearch实现，使底层研究流程更易理解。
summary.en: Refactoring the open-source Jina DeepSearch implementation serves as a way to expose and study its underlying logic.

summary.zh: VSCode可加入类似Cursor的下一处编辑补全能力。
summary.en: The post highlights a VSCode addition that offers Cursor-like suggestions for the next code edit.

summary.zh: STORM展示了以研究支撑文章生成的复杂AI工作流。
summary.en: STORM offers an example of a complex AI workflow aimed at producing articles grounded in research.

summary.zh: 智能体通过编排层结合记忆、推理与工具，形成面向目标的行动循环。
summary.en: An agent combines memory, reasoning, and external tools through an orchestration loop that guides actions toward a goal.

summary.zh: 发布免费的十六课AI SDK教程，面向TypeScript应用开发。
summary.en: A free sixteen-lesson course introduces practical AI development in TypeScript using the Vercel AI SDK.

summary.zh: AI SDK用统一接口连接不同模型服务，减少切换供应商的适配工作。
summary.en: AI SDK abstracts provider differences so applications can switch models while retaining common streaming, structured output, and tool integrations.

summary.zh: 代理需在工具执行后继续推理，才能将返回结果转成回答。
summary.en: Tool execution alone may leave a request unanswered; an agent needs further generation steps to respond using the result.

summary.zh: 为对象定义Zod结构，并设置数组输出，可批量生成结构化数据。
summary.en: Define each item with Zod and select array output in generateObject to produce collections of structured data.

summary.zh: AI SDK教程涵盖模型切换、流式输出、结构化数据与工具调用。
summary.en: The tutorial teaches model switching, streaming, structured generation, multimodal inputs, and agent development through the AI SDK.

summary.zh: AI SDK可将图片字节或网址传给视觉模型，生成无障碍替代文本。
summary.en: Image bytes or URLs can be sent through AI SDK to a vision-capable model to produce accessible image descriptions.

summary.zh: 用AI SDK限定枚举输出，可将评论情感归为三类。
summary.en: Constrain AI SDK output to predefined enum values to classify comments by sentiment.

summary.zh: 将内容转为向量后，可按余弦相似度排序实现语义检索。
summary.en: Embed stored items and a query, then rank their cosine similarities to implement semantic search.

summary.zh: 用Zod定义字段，再让AI SDK从PDF发票提取结构化数据。
summary.en: Describe invoice fields with Zod, then provide the PDF to generateObject to obtain structured information suitable for storage and querying.

summary.zh: AI SDK工具通过参数模式、说明和执行函数，将模型请求连接到实际操作。
summary.en: AI SDK tools pair parameter schemas and descriptions with executable functions, enabling model requests to trigger application actions.

summary.zh: streamObject逐步返回部分对象，可实时展示结构化生成进度。
summary.en: Use streamObject to consume partial structured results as they arrive, then await the completed object.

summary.zh: streamText返回异步流，可逐块发送模型生成的文本。
summary.en: Use the asynchronous stream returned by streamText to deliver generated output incrementally as chunks arrive.

summary.zh: AI SDK可通过system参数或系统消息设定模型行为。
summary.en: The AI SDK accepts behavior instructions through a system option or a system-role message before the user input.

summary.zh: AI SDK可通过兼容接口连接LM Studio等本地模型服务。
summary.en: An OpenAI-compatible provider lets AI SDK connect to locally hosted models, including those served by LM Studio.

summary.zh: 通过LanguageModel参数注入模型，可将业务逻辑与模型选择解耦。
summary.en: Inject a LanguageModel into shared generation functions to change providers without rewriting application logic.

summary.zh: 将带字段说明的Zod结构传给generateObject，获取类型化结果。
summary.en: Give generateObject a Zod schema with field descriptions to obtain structured results with typed property access.

summary.zh: 将带角色的历史消息传给模型，可为后续追问提供上下文。
summary.en: Maintain a typed array of role-tagged messages so a chatbot can reuse earlier conversation context when answering follow-up questions.

summary.zh: 为generateText提供模型和提示，即可从返回结果中读取生成文本。
summary.en: AI SDK text generation pairs a selected provider model with a prompt and returns the generated response.

summary.zh: Vercel AI SDK统一模型接口，可减少切换供应商的改造成本。
summary.en: A shared AI SDK interface reduces provider-specific integration code and makes changing model vendors easier.

summary.zh: 该综述按技术类别整理提示工程研究，并提供延伸论文。
summary.en: The survey organizes prompting research into a taxonomy of techniques and links readers to more specialized papers.

summary.zh: 分享Node.js运行TypeScript所需配置的介绍。
summary.en: The post announces Node.js support for TypeScript and shares an accompanying configuration guide.

summary.zh: 工作流沿预设路径执行，智能体则根据环境反馈自主决定后续行动。
summary.en: Workflows follow predetermined paths, while agents select their next actions using feedback from tools and the environment.

summary.zh: 一个Node变更提案希望默认启用TypeScript支持。
summary.en: A Node pull request proposes enabling TypeScript execution by default.

summary.zh: Total TypeScript累计毛收入达到三百万美元。
summary.en: Total TypeScript reports cumulative gross revenue of three million dollars.

summary.zh: Evalite预览版展示基于Vitest的本地TypeScript评测工具。
summary.en: Evalite previews a Vitest-based evaluation tool for TypeScript AI apps, designed for local runs and inspection of scores and traces.

summary.zh: 模型评估可结合规则检查、模型评分与人工判断。
summary.en: Evaluate model behavior using deterministic checks, model-based scoring, and human judgment according to what needs assessing.

summary.zh: MCP通过JSON-RPC让助手发现并调用连接数据源的工具。
summary.en: MCP uses JSON-RPC so assistants can discover server-provided tools and invoke actions connected to external data sources.

summary.zh: 生成式AI的实用价值可体现在后台的数据提取、摘要与语义检索。
summary.en: Generative AI can improve ordinary backend tasks such as extraction, summarization, and semantic search without becoming the user interface.

summary.zh: 对AI输出持续评分，才能判断模型或提示改动是否改善质量。
summary.en: Automated evaluations measure AI output quality across changes, helping detect regressions that casual manual checks can miss.

summary.zh: using关键字可用于临时目录的自动清理。
summary.en: The using keyword can help manage cleanup of temporary directories.

summary.zh: 作者推荐按项目类型选择现成脚手架，替代购买模板。
summary.en: The author recommends established project starters such as epic-stack, create-t3-app, and create-typescript-app as alternatives to paid boilerplates.

summary.zh: Node的inspect可通过配置调整对象日志的显示方式。
summary.en: Configure Node inspect to control how objects appear in diagnostic logs.

summary.zh: 为Fastify声明输出结构，可提高JSON序列化速度。
summary.en: Declaring a response schema in Fastify can improve JSON serialization performance, with the post reporting a two-to-threefold gain.

summary.zh: 本地数据库测试应明确连接localhost，避免误操作其他环境。
summary.en: Ensure local database tests connect to localhost to avoid directing test operations at another environment.

summary.zh: 把console.dir的depth设为Infinity，可展开深层对象。
summary.en: Set the console.dir depth option to Infinity to inspect nested objects without depth-based truncation.

summary.zh: 恶意依赖可读取并外传运行时环境变量中的秘密。
summary.en: A malicious package can read runtime environment variables and transmit their contents to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

summary.zh: 内置crypto.randomUUID可生成随机UUID，无需额外安装依赖。
summary.en: The built-in crypto.randomUUID API can generate random UUIDs without an additional package.

summary.zh: Node可直接模拟fetch调用，用于替代真实网络请求。
summary.en: Node provides native support for simulating fetch calls.

summary.zh: 建议对外部数据使用Zod严格校验，减少数据处理漏洞。
summary.en: The author recommends strict Zod schemas for incoming data after using strict validation to resolve a bug.

summary.zh: TypeScript开发仍以JavaScript为基础，不能忽视其语言行为。
summary.en: Working in TypeScript still means writing JavaScript, so developers should keep the underlying language in mind.

summary.zh: 有时保留直接实现，比增加抽象更合适。
summary.en: Some problems are better served by direct implementation than by introducing an abstraction.

summary.zh: 作者考虑讲解JavaScript底层的缓冲区与UTF-8。
summary.en: The author proposes an explanation of buffers and UTF-8 as lower-level JavaScript topics.

summary.zh: 作者推荐新项目采用Remix、TypeScript及配套测试与数据库工具。
summary.en: The proposed greenfield stack combines Remix, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vitest, Playwright, Prisma, and Postgres.

summary.zh: TypeScript 5.6优先检查可见代码，改善大型文件的编辑反馈。
summary.en: TypeScript 5.6 prioritizes visible code when reporting diagnostics, improving editor responsiveness in large files.

summary.zh: PropertyKey涵盖字符串、数字和符号三种属性键。
summary.en: The built-in PropertyKey type covers the string, number, and symbol forms of JavaScript property keys.

summary.zh: 该指南展示从空目录创建并发布可投入使用的npm包。
summary.en: The guide walks through preparing and publishing an npm package, starting from an empty project directory.

summary.zh: 返回自定义错误可显式表达失败类型，并用instanceof区分。
summary.en: Returning custom error objects exposes failures in function return types and enables instanceof checks without an extra library.

summary.zh: 该帖分享宽松自动补全模式的示例。
summary.en: The post points to an example demonstrating the loose autocomplete pattern.

summary.zh: 作者建议用Set替代存放唯一值的数组，作为枚举的替代方案。
summary.en: The post proposes a Set as an alternative to unique-value arrays used in place of TypeScript enums.

summary.zh: 帖子介绍Node 22新增的实验性glob函数。
summary.en: The post highlights an experimental glob function introduced in Node 22.

summary.zh: TypeScript的{}类型仅排除null与undefined。
summary.en: In TypeScript, the empty object type excludes null and undefined but does not require an object value.

summary.zh: 复杂类型的内部实现，也可以配上易于使用的接口。
summary.en: Sophisticated type definitions can still present a straightforward experience to their users.

summary.zh: 介绍面向应用开发的宽松自动补全类型技巧。
summary.en: The post highlights a TypeScript technique for loose autocomplete as useful in application development.

summary.zh: 帖子介绍主流浏览器均已支持的内置structuredClone。
summary.en: The post introduces structuredClone as an API built into all major browsers.

summary.zh: 库的类型可围绕使用它们的函数组织，以改善类型查找体验。
summary.en: The author proposes exposing library types alongside the functions that use them instead of only as top-level exports.

summary.zh: Node 22.6.0引入TypeScript支持，并需配套编译配置。
summary.en: Node 22.6.0 introduces TypeScript support, accompanied by guidance on required compiler configuration changes.

summary.zh: 该VSCode扩展把TypeScript诊断改写成易懂的英文。
summary.en: This VSCode extension rephrases TypeScript diagnostics in accessible English.

summary.zh: 注册事件监听器时可以传入中止信号。
summary.en: Event listener registration accepts an abort signal through addEventListener.

summary.zh: 可用createReadStream配合异步迭代处理文件，避免整份载入内存。
summary.en: Combining createReadStream with asynchronous iteration processes files incrementally instead of loading all their contents into memory.

summary.zh: 在CI中用node --run执行脚本，可减少逐次启动开销。
summary.en: Using node --run for CI scripts can reduce the startup overhead of each script invocation.

summary.zh: Node内置可等待的定时器，无需自行封装休眠函数。
summary.en: Node offers an awaitable timer, avoiding the need to implement a custom delay helper.

summary.zh: 作者宣布Total TypeScript累计销售额突破250万美元。
summary.en: The author announces that Total TypeScript sales have passed 2.5 million dollars and credits the team behind the project.

summary.zh: 把耗时检查移到CI，可减少提交钩子对开发者的等待开销。
summary.en: Moving expensive checks from commit hooks to CI can reduce time developers spend waiting locally.

summary.zh: 作者发布免费TypeScript书籍及包含两百道练习的新课程。
summary.en: The release introduces a free TypeScript book and a new course containing two hundred exercises.

summary.zh: 预告免费在线TypeScript书籍，内容从编辑器设置到泛型。
summary.en: An upcoming TypeScript book offers sixteen chapters, from editor setup to generics, with free online access.

summary.zh: Corepack可依据packageManager字段获取指定的包管理器版本。
summary.en: Corepack can obtain the package-manager version specified by the packageManager field in project metadata.

summary.zh: 作者认为单体仓库虽有缺点，仍适合管理复杂系统。
summary.en: The author considers a monorepo preferable to other approaches for managing a complex system, despite its drawbacks.

summary.zh: 新配置包可让TypeScript项目通过单次导入复用作者推荐的编译配置。
summary.en: The new @total-typescript/tsconfig package exposes recommended TypeScript compiler settings through a single import.

summary.zh: TypeScript 5.5将支持从收窄函数自动推断类型谓词。
summary.en: TypeScript 5.5 adds inference of type predicates from suitable narrowing functions, reducing the need for explicit annotations.

summary.zh: API封装可依据Zod模式推导类型，并自动处理校验失败响应。
summary.en: An API helper can infer types from a Zod schema and produce HTTP 400 responses for validation failures.

summary.zh: 用Zod集中校验环境变量，再将推导类型用于应用中的process.env。
summary.en: Validating environment variables with Zod can supply inferred types for process.env throughout an application.

summary.zh: gql.tada可直接从GraphQL字符串推断类型。
summary.en: The gql.tada library derives TypeScript types directly from GraphQL query strings.

summary.zh: 该指南介绍为Vite、Node及浏览器的全局和环境变量添加类型。
summary.en: The guide covers typing globals and environment variables across Vite, Node, and browser contexts.

summary.zh: using可在作用域结束时自动清理测试替身，减少手写清理钩子。
summary.en: Scope-based disposal with using can automatically clean up test mocks, reducing the need for explicit cleanup hooks.

summary.zh: 用as const保留对象字面量信息，可进一步构造路由联合类型。
summary.en: An object preserved with as const can serve as the basis for a union of route types.

summary.zh: const类型参数有助于泛型函数获得预期的类型推断。
summary.en: Const type parameters help generic functions infer the intended types.

summary.zh: NoInfer可限制泛型推导来源，避免初始值扩大允许的状态集合。
summary.en: NoInfer controls which arguments drive generic inference, keeping an initial state constrained to the supplied set of states.

summary.zh: 泛型可用于封装带完整类型约束的fetch函数。
